name: RC–B10–0157/2025 – § 31 – Am 33
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for EU support towards a just transition and reconstruction in Syria
part_text: 31.Condemns those European politicians, including current and former MEPs, who have repeatedly spread pro-Islamist narratives and actively engaged in whitewashing ruthless terrorist groups such as Al-Qaeda; expresses deep concern regarding the lack of interest from Parliament towards Eastern Christians who are actively persecuted by radical Islamists;
